attackers_goals: Use the AppleScript interpreter to execute a second-stage payload.
description: An uncommon process has been executed by the AppleScript interpreter process.
investigative_actions: Analyze the AppleScript and executed process to determine whether they perform any malicious or suspicious actions. Check the events generated by the process or its children for potential malicious behavior. Check whether the AppleScript was executed in an unusual way.
name: Rare process executed by an AppleScript
